title: First Night at the Flagon
description: Mara Hearthstone has seen a great many strangers come through her door, and she can tell the ones who have never worked a job board. She will walk you through a night's work, one small lesson at a time. You may stop whenever you like.

talk.title: Hear Mara out
talk.objective: Talk to Mara at the bar and hear her job. Pick a reply from the list under her words; the ones with a die beside them are rolled for you. If she offers a coin more than she said, ask for it.
talk.journal: Mara says I have the look of somebody who has never worked a job board. She has a rat problem and an hour to spare.

journal.title: Write it down
journal.objective: Open the journal (press J, or use the Journal button) and find this quest in it. Then speak to Mara again.
journal.journal: Mara says to write it down if I am the forgetting kind. The journal does the writing for me.

errand.title: Tobin's lantern
errand.objective: Fetch Mara's lantern from Tobin at Tobin's Goods. Use the exits listed on the location screen, or click the places on the map: out of the Flagon to the High Street, up to the Market Square, then into Tobin's Goods. Talk to Tobin.
errand.journal: Tobin keeps a lantern of Mara's, against a debt he has not forgotten. Out to the High Street, up to the Market Square, and into his shop.

the_rats.title: Mind the third step
the_rats.objective: Back down the High Street to the Flagon, then take the Down to the cellar exit. The rats will be waiting, and the fight begins the moment you arrive. When it is quiet, come back up and tell Mara.
the_rats.journal: I have the lantern. The rats are in the cellar, and the third step is loose.

loot.title: Something on the floor
loot.objective: Go back down to the cellar and press Search, then Take what lies on the floor. Bring it up to Mara.
loot.journal: The rats are dead. Mara says there is something of hers lying in the cellar, and that Search is how you find what is lying about.

search.title: The draught
search.objective: Mara says there is a draught in the cellar she cannot find. Go down and press Search again. A way you had not noticed will appear among the exits.
search.journal: There is a draught in that cellar and Mara cannot find where it comes from. Searching is how I find things that do not want to be found.

rest.title: Room's on the house
rest.objective: Talk to Mara and take the room she is offering. Out on the road, the Camp button does the same job where there is no inn.
rest.journal: I have been bleeding on Mara's floor. She is giving me a bed for the night.

done.title: That's the Flagon
done.journal: Mara showed me how the Flagon works: the board, the journal, the road to Tobin's, the cellar, the Search button, a bed. The rest of Rivermark is less forgiving.

skipped.title: Got it from here
skipped.journal: Mara asked if I wanted the tour. I said I had it from here. She went back to her cloth.
